verdict.rationale: PayPal documents a dedicated sandbox that is a self-contained virtual mirror of production, using sandbox accounts/credentials so API calls (including the same REST rails used by cart API and agent toolkit tools) never touch live PayPal accounts. This directly supports AI-native testing without production data exposure. Missing for 10: no explicit mention of sandbox support for the newer agentic-commerce-specific endpoints (createcart/getcart, Store Sync) or independent hands-on confirmation that agentic flows work end-to-end in sandbox mode.
